outcome: Obstetric intervention for suspected intrapartum fetal compromise (Cesarean section or instrumental delivery)
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Composite adverse perinatal outcome (acidemia in the umbilical artery, 5-min Apgar score < 7, or NICU admission)
cohort: Low-risk term pregnancies with spontaneous onset of labor
finding: Increased mean uterine artery PI in early labor was independently associated with obstetric intervention for suspected intrapartum fetal compromise and composite adverse perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: The study examined uterine artery Doppler in predicting intrapartum fetal compromise and did not focus on mode of delivery as a primary variable.
